query_snapshot: Which alloy and heat-treatment conditions does NASA SP-8119 identify as susceptible to stress corrosion in its material-compatibility discussion?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- NASA SP-8119 identifies aluminum alloy 2024 in the T3 temper (2024‑T3) as susceptible to stress‑corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 identifies precipitation‑hardening stainless steel 17‑7PH in the annealed condition as susceptible to stress‑corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 identifies precipitation‑hardening stainless steel 17‑4PH in H‑tempers (example given as H900 and other H tempers) as susceptible to stress‑corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
